newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna sees overseas unit making losses.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna sees overseas unit making losses.

text.p: Indonesia cigarette maker PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna said on Monday it sees subsidiary Sampoerna International making losses for the next three or four years.
"Sampoerna International may continue making losses for the next three to four years," director of corporate development Jonathan Zax told Reuters.
Sampoerna recently announced 1996 net profit of 394 billion rupiah, below its target of 423 billion rupiah.
The company has said the poor performance was partly due to losses incurred by Sampoerna International.
Zax said Sampoerna International's losses in 1996 totalled some $3 million more than expected.
Sampoerna International was expected to continue making losses following its expansion into Vietnam and other Asian countries, said Zax.
He declined to give further details.
